topics.title: The quadratic formulae and the graph

questions.stem: Use the quadratic formula to find the roots \( \alpha \) and \( \beta \) of \( x^2 - 4x + 2 = 0 \). Hence show that both \( \alpha + \beta = -\frac{b}{a} \) and \( \alpha\beta = \frac{c}{a} \) hold.
questions.hint: Write a full structured solution for the teacher to mark.

steps.explain: Identify coefficients: \( a=1, b=-4, c=2 \). Apply quadratic formula.
Compute the sum of the roots.
Compute the product of the roots.
